|---|---|---|

sections.title: 📐 语法：现在进行时的被动语态
sections.body:
**结构**：am / is / are **being** + 过去分词

| 主语 | 形式 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| I | am being + done | I **am being** watched. |
| he / she / it | is being + done | The road **is being** repaired. |
| we / they | are being + done | The trees **are being** planted. |

**用法**：表示"此刻正在被……"，强调动作正在进行且主语是承受者。

**与一般现在时被动的区别**：
- The classroom **is cleaned** every day.（每天都被打扫——习惯）
- The classroom **is being cleaned** now.（此刻正在被打扫——进行）

**易错边界**
1. 漏掉 being：The road is repaired now.（×，缺"正在"）
2. being 后误用动词原形：is being repair（×）
3. 状态动词一般不用进行时：is being belonged to（×）

**三个练习**
1. The bridge ________ (build) at the moment. → **is being built**
2. Look! The car ________ (wash) by my father. → **is being washed**
3. 改错：The house is being paint by workers. → **painted**

sections.title: ✍️ 写作：非正式信件（informal letter）
sections.body:
**结构**：称呼 → 开头问候 → 主体（2 段：学校生活 + 感受）→ 结尾期待回信 → 署名

**五个可套用句式**
1. **How's it going?** 最近怎么样？
2. **I've been here for a week, and I'm slowly getting used to...** 我来这儿一周了，正慢慢适应……
3. **The thing I like most is...** 我最喜欢的是……
4. **It's a bit hard to..., but I'm working on it.** ……有点难，但我正在努力。
5. **Write back soon and tell me about...** 快回信，跟我说说……

sections.body: 说明文/记叙文的主题句常在**段首或段尾**。先看首句，再看末句；如果首句是细节，末句往往总结。练习时用笔划出每段第一句，读完再回看是否覆盖全段。

sections.title: 例题 1 · L1 词汇
sections.body:
用方框中的词填空：digital / typical / routine / earn / challenge

1. It is a ______ day for a student: classes, lunch, homework.
2. Many people ______ a living by writing.
3. Learning a new language is a real ______.
4. My morning ______ starts with a run.
5. We live in a ______ age.

**解析**：1. typical　2. earn　3. challenge　4. routine　5. digital

**💥 陷阱**：第 1 题容易填 digital（"数字的一天"），但句意是"典型的一天"。

**变式**：用 inspire 造句，表达"这本书激励我学英语"。（The book inspired me to learn English.）

sections.title: 例题 2 · L2 语法
sections.body:
把下列句子改为现在进行时的被动语态：
1. They are building a new library.
2. Someone is repairing my bike.
3. The workers are planting trees.

**解析**：
1. A new library **is being built**.
2. My bike **is being repaired**.
3. Trees **are being planted** by the workers.

**💥 陷阱**：第 1 题漏掉 being，写成 is built，变成"一般现在时被动"。

**变式**：把 "The room is being cleaned." 改为一般疑问句。（Is the room being cleaned?）

sections.title: 例题 3 · L3 翻译
sections.body:
翻译下列句子：
1. 这所学校正在被重建，所以我们暂时在临时教室里上课。
2. 让我印象最深的是这里的人：他们总是乐于回应别人的求助。
3. 虽然日程很紧，我还是设法按时完成了项目。

**参考译文**：
1. The school **is being rebuilt**, so we are having classes in temporary classrooms for now.
2. What **impressed** me most was the people here: they are always ready to **respond to** others' requests for help.
3. Although the **schedule** was tight, I managed to finish the project **on schedule**.

**采分点**：① 现在进行时被动 is being rebuilt；② impress 的用法 / respond to；③ on schedule 与 although 引导的让步状语从句。

**💥 陷阱**：第 1 句写成 is rebuilt（缺"正在"）；第 3 句把 on schedule 写成 in schedule。

**变式**：把第 2 句改为强调句：It was the people here that impressed me most.

sections.body:

sections.title: 30 秒概述
sections.body: 本单元以"地方"为主题，读一篇介绍历史名城的文章（Where history comes alive），学**过去将来时**（would do / was going to do / was about to do），写一篇**旅行博客**。词汇集中在旅行、历史遗迹与个人感受。

sections.title: 30 秒自评
sections.body:
1. historic 和 historical 都能表示"历史的"吗？
2. "He said he would come." 中的 would 表示什么？
3. "be about to do" 的意思是"即将做"还是"打算做"？

> **答案**：1. 能，但 historic 强调"有历史意义的"，historical 强调"与历史有关的"　2. 过去将来（站在过去看将来）　3. 即将做（通常不与具体时间状语连用）

sections.title: 🔑 核心词汇（10）
sections.body:
- **destination** n. 目的地：reach the **destination** 到达目的地；a tourist **destination** 旅游胜地
- **historic** adj. 有历史意义的：a **historic** site 历史遗址；a **historic** moment 历史性时刻
- **former** adj. 以前的：the **former** capital 旧都；a **former** teacher 以前的老师
- **view** n. 景色；观点：a wonderful **view** 美景；in my **view** 在我看来
- **memory** n. 记忆：childhood **memories** 童年记忆；in **memory** of 为了纪念
- **contribute** v. 贡献；促成：**contribute** to 有助于；**contribute** money 捐钱
- **opportunity** n. 机会：a golden **opportunity** 绝佳机会；take the **opportunity** to do 趁机做
- **transport** n./v. 交通；运输：public **transport** 公共交通；**transport** goods 运输货物
- **disappoint** v. 使失望：be **disappointed** at 对……失望；a **disappointing** result 令人失望的结果
- **adventure** n. 冒险：an **adventure** story 冒险故事；go on an **adventure** 去冒险

sections.title: 🧩 短语与搭配（8）
sections.body:
| 短语 | 意思 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| be famous for | 因……而闻名 | The city **is famous for** its old bridges. |
| date back to | 追溯到 | The temple **dates back to** the Tang Dynasty. |
| in memory of | 为了纪念 | The statue was built **in memory of** the poet. |
| contribute to | 有助于；促成 | Tourism **contributes to** the local economy. |
| take the opportunity to do | 趁机做 | We **took the opportunity to** visit the old town. |
| be worth visiting | 值得参观 | The museum **is worth visiting**. |
| get around | 四处走动 | It is easy to **get around** the city by bike. |
| in the distance | 在远处 | We saw a tower **in the distance**. |

sections.title: 📐 语法：过去将来时
sections.body:
**结构**：would + 动词原形；was / were going to + 动词原形；was / were about to + 动词原形

| 形式 | 含义 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| would do | 站在过去看将来 | He said he **would visit** the site. |
| was/were going to do | 过去打算做 | We **were going to** leave at six. |
| was/were about to do | 过去即将做 | She **was about to** speak when the bell rang. |

**用法**：常用于宾语从句（said, thought, knew 之后）或叙述过去某时之后将发生的事。

**易错边界**
1. 与一般将来时混用：He said he will come.（×，主句过去时，从句用 would）
2. was about to 后加具体时间：was about to leave at six（×，about to 强调"马上"，不加具体时间）
3. would 与 used to 混淆：would 只表"过去常做（带感情）"，used to 强调"现在不做了"

**三个练习**
1. He told me he ________ (come) back the next week. → **would come**
2. They ________ (leave) when it began to rain. → **were about to leave**
3. 改错：She said she is going to visit the museum. → **was going to**

sections.title: ✍️ 写作：旅行博客（travel blog）
sections.body:
**结构**：吸引人的标题 → 时间地点 → 2–3 个亮点（用过去时叙事）→ 实用建议 → 一句感受

**五个可套用句式**
1. **If you ever get the chance, don't miss...** 有机会千万别错过……
2. **The moment I stepped into..., I knew...** 我一走进……就知道……
3. **What impressed me most was...** 最让我印象深刻的是……
4. **A word of advice: ...** 一句建议：……
5. **I left with a memory I will keep for ever.** 我带着一段永远珍藏的记忆离开。

sections.title: 📖 阅读技能：扫读找细节（scanning）
sections.body: 先看题干中的**关键词**（人名、地名、数字、时间），再回到原文快速"扫"这些词，不必逐句读。找到关键词后，读它前后各一句，答案通常就在附近。

sections.body:

**⚡ 先猜**："I would visit the museum the next day." 里的 would 表示"过去将来"还是"客气"？

### 30 秒概述

本单元以"地方"为主题，读一篇介绍历史名城的文章（Where history comes alive），学**过去将来时**（would do / was going to do / was about to do），写一篇**旅行博客**。词汇集中在旅行、历史遗迹与个人感受。

### 30 秒自评

1. historic 和 historical 都能表示"历史的"吗？
2. "He said he would come." 中的 would 表示什么？
3. "be about to do" 的意思是"即将做"还是"打算做"？

> **答案**：1. 能，但 historic 强调"有历史意义的"，historical 强调"与历史有关的"　2. 过去将来（站在过去看将来）　3. 即将做（通常不与具体时间状语连用）

### 🔑 核心词汇（10）

- **destination** n. 目的地：reach the **destination** 到达目的地；a tourist **destination** 旅游胜地
- **historic** adj. 有历史意义的：a **historic** site 历史遗址；a **historic** moment 历史性时刻
- **former** adj. 以前的：the **former** capital 旧都；a **former** teacher 以前的老师
- **view** n. 景色；观点：a wonderful **view** 美景；in my **view** 在我看来
- **memory** n. 记忆：childhood **memories** 童年记忆；in **memory** of 为了纪念
- **contribute** v. 贡献；促成：**contribute** to 有助于；**contribute** money 捐钱
- **opportunity** n. 机会：a golden **opportunity** 绝佳机会；take the **opportunity** to do 趁机做
- **transport** n./v. 交通；运输：public **transport** 公共交通；**transport** goods 运输货物
- **disappoint** v. 使失望：be **disappointed** at 对……失望；a **disappointing** result 令人失望的结果
- **adventure** n. 冒险：an **adventure** story 冒险故事；go on an **adventure** 去冒险

### 🧩 短语与搭配（8）

| 短语 | 意思 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| be famous for | 因……而闻名 | The city **is famous for** its old bridges. |
| date back to | 追溯到 | The temple **dates back to** the Tang Dynasty. |
| in memory of | 为了纪念 | The statue was built **in memory of** the poet. |
| contribute to | 有助于；促成 | Tourism **contributes to** the local economy. |
| take the opportunity to do | 趁机做 | We **took the opportunity to** visit the old town. |
| be worth visiting | 值得参观 | The museum **is worth visiting**. |
| get around | 四处走动 | It is easy to **get around** the city by bike. |
| in the distance | 在远处 | We saw a tower **in the distance**. |

### 📐 语法：过去将来时

**结构**：would + 动词原形；was / were going to + 动词原形；was / were about to + 动词原形

| 形式 | 含义 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| would do | 站在过去看将来 | He said he **would visit** the site. |
| was/were going to do | 过去打算做 | We **were going to** leave at six. |
| was/were about to do | 过去即将做 | She **was about to** speak when the bell rang. |

**用法**：常用于宾语从句（said, thought, knew 之后）或叙述过去某时之后将发生的事。

**易错边界**
1. 与一般将来时混用：He said he will come.（×，主句过去时，从句用 would）
2. was about to 后加具体时间：was about to leave at six（×，about to 强调"马上"，不加具体时间）

sections.title: 🔑 核心词汇（10）
sections.body:
- **convenience** n. 便利：for **convenience** 为了方便；a **convenience** store 便利店
- **label** n./v. 标签；贴标签：read the **label** 看标签；**label** the box 给盒子贴标签
- **recycle** v. 回收利用：**recycle** paper 回收纸；a **recycling** bin 回收箱
- **facility** n. 设施：public **facilities** 公共设施；sports **facilities** 体育设施
- **amount** n. 数量：a large **amount** of 大量的（接不可数名词）
- **impact** n. 影响：have an **impact** on 对……有影响
- **determine** v. 决定；确定：**determine** to do 决心做；be **determined** to do 下定决心做
- **source** n. 来源：the **source** of energy 能源来源；a reliable **source** 可靠来源
- **consumer** n. 消费者：**consumer** rights 消费者权益；a **consumer** society 消费社会
- **establish** v. 建立；确立：**establish** a company 创办公司；**establish** a habit 养成习惯

sections.title: 🧩 短语与搭配（8）
sections.body:
| 短语 | 意思 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| a large amount of | 大量的 | The factory uses **a large amount of** water. |
| have an impact on | 对……有影响 | Packaging **has an impact on** the environment. |
| be determined to do | 下定决心做 | She **was determined to** change her diet. |
| a source of | ……的来源 | Sunlight is **a source of** energy. |
| tend to do | 往往做 | Teenagers **tend to** buy snacks after school. |
| remind somebody of | 使某人想起 | The label **reminded me of** my grandmother's kitchen. |
| apologize to somebody for | 因……向某人道歉 | He **apologized to** us **for** the mistake. |
| despite / in spite of | 尽管 | **Despite** the price, the product sold well. |

sections.title: 📐 语法：关系代词引导的定语从句
sections.body:
| 关系代词 | 指代 | 在从句中作 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|---|
| who | 人 | 主语/宾语 | the girl **who** won the prize |
| whom | 人 | 宾语（正式） | the man **whom** we met |
| which | 物 | 主语/宾语 | the box **which** is made of plastic |
| that | 人/物 | 主语/宾语 | the book **that** I bought |
| whose | 人/物 | 定语（所属） | the student **whose** idea won |

**要点**
1. 关系代词作宾语时可以省略：the book (that) I bought
2. 介词提前时只能用 whom / which：the person **to whom** I spoke
3. **非限制性**定语从句用逗号隔开，不能用 that：My teacher, **who** is from Canada, ...

**易错边界**
1. 指人用 which：the man which helped me（×）
2. 从句缺主语却省略关系代词：the book I bought it（×，it 多余）
3. whose 后直接跟名词：whose **idea**（√），whose **is** idea（×）

**三个练习**
1. This is the shop ________ sells recycled bags. → **which / that**
2. The girl ________ hair is curly is my sister. → **whose**
3. 改错：The man who he called me is my uncle. → 去掉 he

sections.title: 例题 1 · L1 词汇
sections.body:
用方框中的词填空：convenience / label / recycle / facility / impact

1. The ______ on the bottle tells you what is inside.
2. We should ______ plastic and paper instead of throwing them away.
3. The new sports ______ is open to all students.
4. For ______, the shop stays open until midnight.
5. Fast food has a big ______ on our health.

**解析**：1. label　2. recycle　3. facility　4. convenience　5. impact

**💥 陷阱**：第 3 题 facility 常用复数 facilities，注意主谓一致（is open 单数，此处指一个场馆）。

sections.title: 例题 2 · L2 语法
sections.body:
合并句子（用关系代词）：
1. I know a girl. Her father is a doctor.
2. This is the bag. I bought it yesterday.
3. The man is our teacher. We met him at the gate.

**解析**：
1. I know a girl **whose** father is a doctor.
2. This is the bag **(which/that)** I bought yesterday.
3. The man **(whom/who/that)** we met at the gate is our teacher.

**💥 陷阱**：第 3 题保留 him，从句出现两个宾语；第 1 题用 who 代替 whose。

**变式**：把第 2 句改为非限制性定语从句。→ This bag, which I bought yesterday, is made of recycled plastic.

sections.title: 例题 3 · L3 翻译
sections.body:
翻译下列句子：
1. 这家便利店使用可回收包装，这对环境有积极影响。
2. 那个建议我们少买塑料瓶的女孩是我的同桌。
3. 尽管价格更高，消费者仍然愿意购买有环保标签的产品。

**参考译文**：
1. The **convenience** store uses **recyclable** packaging, **which has a positive impact on** the environment.
2. The girl **who advised us to buy fewer plastic bottles** is my deskmate.
3. **Despite** the higher price, **consumers** are still willing to buy products **with** an eco-friendly **label**.

**采分点**：① which 引导非限制性定语从句；② who 引导定语从句 + advise sb to do；③ despite + be willing to do。

**💥 陷阱**：第 1 句用 what 引导从句（×）；第 3 句 despite 后接句子（×，应接名词）。

**变式**：把第 1 句改为两个简单句。→ The convenience store uses recyclable packaging. This has a positive impact on the environment.

sections.title: 30 秒自评
sections.body:
1. a bored student 和 a boring student 意思一样吗？
2. -ed 形容词通常修饰"人"，-ing 形容词通常修饰"物"吗？

> **答案**：1. 不一样（感到无聊的学生 / 令人无聊的学生）　2. 大体如此（也有例外，如 a frightened look）　3. 不同（发展中国家 / 发达国家）

- **episode** n. 一集；一段经历：the latest **episode** 最新一集；a painful **episode** 痛苦的经历

- **effect** n. 影响；效果：have an **effect** on 对……有影响；side **effect** 副作用
- **motivate** v. 激励：**motivate** students to do 激励学生做；**motivation** n. 动机

1. -ing 形式作状语时，它的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致吗？

sections.title: 🔑 核心词汇（10）
sections.body:
- **climate** n. 气候：**climate** change 气候变化；a mild **climate** 温和的气候
- **alarming** adj. 令人担忧的：an **alarming** rate 惊人的速度；**alarm** v./n. 警报
- **rate** n. 比率；速度：at a **rate** of 以……的速度；birth **rate** 出生率
- **predict** v. 预测：**predict** the future 预测未来；**prediction** n. 预测
- **agriculture** n. 农业：modern **agriculture** 现代农业；**agricultural** adj. 农业的
- **extinction** n. 灭绝：face **extinction** 面临灭绝；**extinct** adj. 灭绝的
- **reduce** v. 减少：**reduce** by 减少（幅度）；**reduce** to 减少到
- **option** n. 选择：have no **option** but to do 别无选择只能；a better **option** 更好的选择
- **graduate** v./n. 毕业；毕业生：**graduate** from 毕业于；a college **graduate** 大学毕业生
- **fund** n./v. 基金；资助：raise **funds** 筹款；**fund** a project 资助项目

|---|---|---|
| at an alarming rate | 以惊人的速度 | Forests are disappearing **at an alarming rate**. |
| predict the future | 预测未来 | No one can **predict the future** exactly. |
| face extinction | 面临灭绝 | Many species **face extinction**. |
| reduce... by/to | 减少……／到…… | We must **reduce** waste **by** half. |

sections.title: 📐 语法：-ing 形式作状语
sections.body:
| 类型 | 例句 | 相当于 |
|---|---|---|
| 时间 | **Walking** home, I met an old friend. | When I was walking home |
| 原因 | **Being** ill, he didn't come. | Because he was ill |
| 条件 | **Working** hard, you will succeed. | If you work hard |
| 结果 | He fell, **breaking** his leg. | and broke his leg |
| 伴随 | She sat by the window, **reading**. | and read |

**要点**
1. 逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致
2. 完成式 having done 表示动作发生在主句动作之前
3. 否定式 not doing / not having done

**易错边界**
1. 逻辑主语不一致：**Walking** down the street, the shops attracted me.（×，应为 I was attracted...）
2. 完成式与一般式混用：**Finishing** his work, he went home.（应为 Having finished，强调先后）
3. 否定形式错误：**Not** having money, he...（√）；Having not money（×）

**三个练习**
1. ________ (see) from the hill, the city looks beautiful. → **Seen**（注意：此处用过去分词，因 city 被看）
2. ________ (not know) the answer, she kept silent. → **Not knowing**
3. 改错：Having finished the report, the meeting began. → **Having finished the report, he left for the meeting.**（逻辑主语一致）

2. **I would be grateful if you could tell me...** 如能告知……我将不胜感激。

sections.title: 例题 1 · L1 词汇
sections.body:
用方框中的词填空：climate / rate / predict / reduce / option

1. Scientists cannot ______ earthquakes exactly.
2. The birth ______ has fallen in recent years.
3. We have no ______ but to wait.
4. We should ______ the use of plastic.
5. ______ change is a global problem.

**解析**：1. predict　2. rate　3. option　4. reduce　5. Climate

**💥 陷阱**：第 3 题 have no option but to do 中 but 后接带 to 的不定式。

**变式**：用 at an alarming rate 造句，表达"城市以惊人的速度扩张"。→ Cities are expanding at an alarming rate.

sections.title: 例题 2 · L2 语法
sections.body:
用 -ing 形式改写句子：
1. Because he was tired, he went to bed early.
2. After she finished the work, she went shopping.
3. If you turn left, you will see the museum.

**解析**：
1. **Being tired**, he went to bed early.
2. **Having finished the work**, she went shopping.
3. **Turning left**, you will see the museum.

**💥 陷阱**：第 2 题用 Finishing（一般式），未体现"完成在先"。

**变式**：用 -ing 形式合并："He sat by the window. He read a book." → He sat by the window, reading a book.

sections.title: 例题 3 · L3 翻译
sections.body:
翻译下列句子：
1. 森林正以惊人的速度消失，许多物种因此面临灭绝。
2. 为了减少污染，政府别无选择，只能资助公共交通。
3. 看到这些数据，我们意识到必须立即采取行动。

**参考译文**：
1. Forests are disappearing **at an alarming rate**, and many species **face extinction** as a result.
2. To **reduce** pollution, the government **had no option but to** **fund** public transport.
3. **Seeing** these figures, we realized that we must take action **immediately**.

**采分点**：① at an alarming rate + face extinction；② have no option but to do；③ -ing 作状语 + realize that。

**💥 陷阱**：第 3 句 Seeing 的逻辑主语与主句不一致（应为 we）；第 2 句 but 后漏 to。

**变式**：把第 1 句改为定语从句：Forests, which are disappearing at an alarming rate, are home to many species facing extinction.

> 答案：① 逻辑主语一致、动作关系清楚　② 幅度／结果　③ 带 to 的不定式

**⚡ 先猜**："Walking down the street, the shops attracted me." 这句话有什么问题？

### 30 秒概述

本单元讨论"进步"：读一篇关于全球化的文章（Going global），学 **-ing 形式作状语**，写一封**咨询课程的正式邮件**。词汇集中在气候、数据、农业与选择。

### 30 秒自评

1. -ing 形式作状语时，它的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致吗？
2. "Having finished his homework, he went out." 表示动作先后吗？
3. 结果状语可以用 -ing 形式吗？

> **答案**：1. 必须一致　2. 是（完成作业在先）　3. 可以（He fell, breaking his leg.）

### 🔑 核心词汇（10）

- **climate** n. 气候：**climate** change 气候变化；a mild **climate** 温和的气候
- **alarming** adj. 令人担忧的：an **alarming** rate 惊人的速度；**alarm** v./n. 警报
- **rate** n. 比率；速度：at a **rate** of 以……的速度；birth **rate** 出生率
- **predict** v. 预测：**predict** the future 预测未来；**prediction** n. 预测
- **agriculture** n. 农业：modern **agriculture** 现代农业；**agricultural** adj. 农业的
- **extinction** n. 灭绝：face **extinction** 面临灭绝；**extinct** adj. 灭绝的
- **reduce** v. 减少：**reduce** by 减少（幅度）；**reduce** to 减少到
- **option** n. 选择：have no **option** but to do 别无选择只能；a better **option** 更好的选择
- **graduate** v./n. 毕业；毕业生：**graduate** from 毕业于；a college **graduate** 大学毕业生
- **fund** n./v. 基金；资助：raise **funds** 筹款；**fund** a project 资助项目

### 🧩 短语与搭配（8）

| 短语 | 意思 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| at an alarming rate | 以惊人的速度 | Forests are disappearing **at an alarming rate**. |
| predict the future | 预测未来 | No one can **predict the future** exactly. |
| face extinction | 面临灭绝 | Many species **face extinction**. |
| reduce... by/to | 减少……／到…… | We must **reduce** waste **by** half. |
| have no option but to do | 别无选择只能 | They **had no option but to** leave. |
| graduate from | 毕业于 | She **graduated from** a college in Shanghai. |
| raise funds for | 为……筹款 | Students **raised funds for** the project. |
| rely on | 依赖 | Farming **relies on** the weather. |

### 📐 语法：-ing 形式作状语

| 类型 | 例句 | 相当于 |
|---|---|---|
| 时间 | **Walking** home, I met an old friend. | When I was walking home |
| 原因 | **Being** ill, he didn't come. | Because he was ill |
| 条件 | **Working** hard, you will succeed. | If you work hard |
| 结果 | He fell, **breaking** his leg. | and broke his leg |
| 伴随 | She sat by the window, **reading**. | and read |

**要点**
1. 逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致
2. 完成式 having done 表示动作发生在主句动作之前
3. 否定式 not doing / not having done

**易错边界**
1. 逻辑主语不一致：**Walking** down the street, the shops attracted me.（×，应为 I was attracted...）
2. 完成式与一般式混用：**Finishing** his work, he went home.（应为 Having finished，强调先后）
3. 否定形式错误：**Not** having money, he...（√）；Having not money（×）

**三个练习**
1. ________ (see) from the hill, the city looks beautiful. → **Seen**（注意：此处用过去分词，因 city 被看）
2. ________ (not know) the answer, she kept silent. → **Not knowing**
3. 改错：Having finished the report, the meeting began. → **Having finished the report, he left for the meeting.**（逻辑主语一致）

### ✍️ 写作：正式咨询邮件（formal email of enquiry）

**结构**：称呼（Dear Sir/Madam）→ 说明来意 → 具体问题（2–3 个）→ 期待回复 → 署名

**五个可套用句式**
1. **I am writing to enquire about...** 我写信是想咨询……
2. **I would be grateful if you could tell me...** 如能告知……我将不胜感激。
3. **Could you please let me know whether...?** 能否告知是否……？
4. **I would also like to know...** 我还想知道……

### 📖 阅读技能：读数字与趋势

### 例题 1 · L1 词汇

用方框中的词填空：climate / rate / predict / reduce / option

1. Scientists cannot ______ earthquakes exactly.
2. The birth ______ has fallen in recent years.
3. We have no ______ but to wait.
4. We should ______ the use of plastic.
5. ______ change is a global problem.

**解析**：1. predict　2. rate　3. option　4. reduce　5. Climate

**💥 陷阱**：第 3 题 have no option but to do 中 but 后接带 to 的不定式。

### 例题 2 · L2 语法

1. Because he was tired, he went to bed early.
2. After she finished the work, she went shopping.
3. If you turn left, you will see the museum.

1. **Being tired**, he went to bed early.
2. **Having finished the work**, she went shopping.
3. **Turning left**, you will see the museum.

### 例题 3 · L3 翻译

翻译下列句子：
1. 森林正以惊人的速度消失，许多物种因此面临灭绝。
2. 为了减少污染，政府别无选择，只能资助公共交通。
3. 看到这些数据，我们意识到必须立即采取行动。

**参考译文**：
1. Forests are disappearing **at an alarming rate**, and many species **face extinction** as a result.
2. To **reduce** pollution, the government **had no option but to** **fund** public transport.
3. **Seeing** these figures, we realized that we must take action **immediately**.

**采分点**：① at an alarming rate + face extinction；② have no option but to do；③ -ing 作状语 + realize that。

**💥 陷阱**：第 3 句 Seeing 的逻辑主语与主句不一致（应为 we）；第 2 句 but 后漏 to。

**变式**：把第 1 句改为定语从句：Forests, which are disappearing at an alarming rate, are home to many species facing extinction.

> 答案：① 逻辑主语一致、动作关系清楚　② 幅度／结果　③ 带 to 的不定式

sections.title: 30 秒概述
sections.body: 本单元讨论"我们如何看待自己"：读一篇关于"理想美"的文章（Ideal beauty），学**动词不定式作定语**，写一封**给建议专栏的回复**。词汇集中在外貌、代表性、性别与个人形象。

sections.title: 30 秒自评
sections.body:
1. 不定式作定语通常放在被修饰名词之后吗？
2. "something to eat" 中的 to eat 与 something 是动宾关系吗？
3. "the first to arrive" 中的 to arrive 修饰 the first 吗？

> **答案**：1. 是（后置）　2. 是　3. 是

sections.title: 🔑 核心词汇（10）
sections.body:
- **ideal** adj./n. 理想的；理想：an **ideal** body 理想身材；**ideal** conditions 理想条件
- **representation** n. 代表；表现：a **representation** of beauty 美的呈现；**represent** v. 代表
- **generation** n. 一代人：the younger **generation** 年轻一代；**generational** adj. 代际的
- **elegant** adj. 优雅的：an **elegant** dress 优雅的裙子；**elegance** n. 优雅
- **display** v./n. 展示：on **display** 展出；**display** confidence 表现出自信
- **vary** v. 变化；不同：**vary** from...to... 从……到……不等；**variety** n. 多样性
- **context** n. 背景；语境：in the **context** of 在……背景下；**contextual** adj. 上下文的
- **gender** n. 性别：**gender** roles 性别角色；**gender** equality 性别平等
- **personality** n. 个性：a strong **personality** 鲜明的个性；**personal** adj. 个人的
- **impression** n. 印象：make an **impression** on 给……留下印象；**impress** v. 使印象深刻

sections.title: 🧩 短语与搭配（8）
sections.body:

|---|---|---|

sections.title: 📐 语法：动词不定式作定语
sections.body:
| 结构 | 例子 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 名词 + to do | the ability **to adapt** | 表示将要/需要做的动作 |
| something/nothing + to do | something **to eat** | 动宾关系 |
| the first/last/only + to do | the first **to arrive** | 序数词后 |
| have + 名词 + to do | have no time **to waste** | 有时含被动含义 |

**要点**
1. 不定式作定语放在名词后
2. 不及物动词作定语时需加介词：a chair **to sit on**；a pen **to write with**
3. 不定式与所修饰名词有动宾关系时，注意逻辑主语

**易错边界**
1. 漏介词：a pen to write（×，应为 to write with）
2. 位置错误：the to read book（×）
3. 不定式与分词混用：the boiling water（正在烧开）/ the water to boil（要烧开的水）

2. She is always the first ________ (come) and the last ________ (leave). → **to come；to leave**

**结构**：共情（1 句）→ 分析问题（2 句）→ 2–3 条具体建议 → 鼓励（1 句）

**五个可套用句式**
1. **I'm sorry to hear that you...** 听说你……我很难过。
2. **It is normal to feel...** 感到……是正常的。
3. **Here are a few things you could try.** 你可以试试这几件事。
4. **Instead of comparing yourself with others, ...** 与其和别人比较，不如……
5. **Remember that...** 记住……

sections.body: 事实可验证（The survey covered 2,000 teenagers.），观点含评价（Beauty standards are too narrow.）。注意 **should, ought to, beautiful, ugly, better** 等词；题目问 "What is the author's opinion?" 时，找评价性表达。

**解析**：1. vary　2. generation　3. personality　4. display　5. ideal

2. There is nothing ________ (worry) about.
3. He is the only person ________ (know) the truth.

**变式**：用 "a room to live in" 造句：I finally found a room to live in.

sections.title: 例题 3 · L3 翻译
sections.body:
翻译下列句子：
1. 不同文化对美的理解不同，年轻人尤其容易受影响。
2. 与其追求理想的外表，不如培养能让你自信的能力。
3. 给建议专栏写信的那个女孩说，她再也不想被外表评判了。

**参考译文**：
1. Understandings of beauty **vary from** culture **to** culture, and young people are especially easy to **be affected**.
2. **Instead of** chasing an **ideal** appearance, develop the ability **to make** you confident.
3. The girl **who wrote to the advice column** said she **no longer wanted to be judged by** her looks.

**变式**：把第 2 句改为 "It is better to..." 句型：It is better to develop the ability that makes you confident than to chase an ideal appearance.

**⚡ 先猜**："I have no time to watch TV." 中的 to watch TV 修饰什么？

### 30 秒概述

本单元讨论"我们如何看待自己"：读一篇关于"理想美"的文章（Ideal beauty），学**动词不定式作定语**，写一封**给建议专栏的回复**。词汇集中在外貌、代表性、性别与个人形象。

### 30 秒自评

1. 不定式作定语通常放在被修饰名词之后吗？
2. "something to eat" 中的 to eat 与 something 是动宾关系吗？
3. "the first to arrive" 中的 to arrive 修饰 the first 吗？

> **答案**：1. 是（后置）　2. 是　3. 是

### 🔑 核心词汇（10）

- **ideal** adj./n. 理想的；理想：an **ideal** body 理想身材；**ideal** conditions 理想条件
- **representation** n. 代表；表现：a **representation** of beauty 美的呈现；**represent** v. 代表
- **generation** n. 一代人：the younger **generation** 年轻一代；**generational** adj. 代际的
- **elegant** adj. 优雅的：an **elegant** dress 优雅的裙子；**elegance** n. 优雅
- **display** v./n. 展示：on **display** 展出；**display** confidence 表现出自信
- **vary** v. 变化；不同：**vary** from...to... 从……到……不等；**variety** n. 多样性
- **context** n. 背景；语境：in the **context** of 在……背景下；**contextual** adj. 上下文的
- **gender** n. 性别：**gender** roles 性别角色；**gender** equality 性别平等
- **personality** n. 个性：a strong **personality** 鲜明的个性；**personal** adj. 个人的
- **impression** n. 印象：make an **impression** on 给……留下印象；**impress** v. 使印象深刻

### 🧩 短语与搭配（8）

| 短语 | 意思 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| be obsessed with | 痴迷于 | Many teenagers **are obsessed with** looks. |
| make an impression on | 给……留下印象 | Her confidence **made an impression on** us. |
| vary from...to... | 从……到……不等 | Beauty standards **vary from** culture **to** culture. |
| in the context of | 在……背景下 | **In the context of** social media, images matter. |
| on display | 展出 | The photos are **on display** in the hall. |
| be judged by | 根据……评判 | People should not **be judged by** their looks. |
| a sense of identity | 认同感 | Clothes can give us **a sense of identity**. |
| break the stereotype | 打破刻板印象 | The show tries to **break the stereotype**. |

### 📐 语法：动词不定式作定语

| 结构 | 例子 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 名词 + to do | the ability **to adapt** | 表示将要/需要做的动作 |
| something/nothing + to do | something **to eat** | 动宾关系 |
| the first/last/only + to do | the first **to arrive** | 序数词后 |
| have + 名词 + to do | have no time **to waste** | 有时含被动含义 |

**要点**
1. 不定式作定语放在名词后
2. 不及物动词作定语时需加介词：a chair **to sit on**；a pen **to write with**
3. 不定式与所修饰名词有动宾关系时，注意逻辑主语

**易错边界**
1. 漏介词：a pen to write（×，应为 to write with）
2. 位置错误：the to read book（×）
3. 不定式与分词混用：the boiling water（正在烧开）/ the water to boil（要烧开的水）

**三个练习**
1. I need a chair ________ (sit). → **to sit on**
2. She is always the first ________ (come) and the last ________ (leave). → **to come；to leave**
3. 改错：There is nothing to worry. → **There is nothing to worry about.**

### ✍️ 写作：建议专栏回复（advice column reply）

**结构**：共情（1 句）→ 分析问题（2 句）→ 2–3 条具体建议 → 鼓励（1 句）

**五个可套用句式**
1. **I'm sorry to hear that you...** 听说你……我很难过。
2. **It is normal to feel...** 感到……是正常的。
3. **Here are a few things you could try.** 你可以试试这几件事。
4. **Instead of comparing yourself with others, ...** 与其和别人比较，不如……
5. **Remember that...** 记住……

### 📖 阅读技能：区分事实与观点

事实可验证（The survey covered 2,000 teenagers.），观点含评价（Beauty standards are too narrow.）。注意 **should, ought to, beautiful, ugly, better** 等词；题目问 "What is the author's opinion?" 时，找评价性表达。

### 例题 1 · L1 词汇

用方框中的词填空：ideal / generation / display / vary / personality

1. Beauty standards ______ from culture to culture.
2. The younger ______ cares more about self-expression.
3. Her ______ makes her popular among classmates.
4. The photos are on ______ in the school hall.
5. No one has an ______ face.

**解析**：1. vary　2. generation　3. personality　4. display　5. ideal

**💥 陷阱**：第 1 题 vary 的主语是复数 standards，用原形。

**变式**：用 make an impression on 造句，表达"她的演讲给观众留下深刻印象"。→ Her speech made a deep impression on the audience.

### 例题 2 · L2 语法

用不定式完成句子：
1. She has a strong desire ________ (succeed).
2. There is nothing ________ (worry) about.
3. He is the only person ________ (know) the truth.

**解析**：1. **to succeed**　2. **to worry**　3. **to know**

**💥 陷阱**：第 2 题 worry 后保留 about（不定式作定语时介词不能丢）。

**变式**：用 "a room to live in" 造句：I finally found a room to live in.

### 例题 3 · L3 翻译

翻译下列句子：
1. 不同文化对美的理解不同，年轻人尤其容易受影响。
2. 与其追求理想的外表，不如培养能让你自信的能力。
3. 给建议专栏写信的那个女孩说，她再也不想被外表评判了。

**参考译文**：
1. Understandings of beauty **vary from** culture **to** culture, and young people are especially easy to **be affected**.
2. **Instead of** chasing an **ideal** appearance, develop the ability **to make** you confident.
3. The girl **who wrote to the advice column** said she **no longer wanted to be judged by** her looks.

**采分点**：① vary from...to...；② instead of + 动名词；③ who 定语从句 + be judged by。

**💥 陷阱**：第 2 句 instead of 后接 to do（×）；第 3 句 no longer 位置错误。

**变式**：把第 2 句改为 "It is better to..." 句型：It is better to develop the ability that makes you confident than to chase an ideal appearance.

### ⏱️ 限时挑战（60 秒）

① 不定式作定语的位置？② "a pen to write with" 为什么加 with？③ 事实与观点如何区分？

> 答案：① 名词后　② write 不及物，需介词接宾语　③ 事实可验证，观点含评价

### ✅ 接下来做什么

- **3 道全对** → 进入 E-3.4；词汇直接默写"本单元必背 10 词"。
- **对 2 道** → 重读"语法"与"写作"，再做例题 2、3。
- **对 0–1 道** → 从"核心词汇"顺序读到例题 3，再背词表。

> **过关线**：期中做到例题 2｜期末做到例题 3 和变式。

sections.title: 🔑 核心词汇（10）
sections.body:

- **escape** v./n. 逃离：**escape** from 从……逃离；a narrow **escape** 死里逃生
- **highlight** n./v. 亮点；突出：the **highlight** of the trip 旅行亮点；**highlight** the problem 突出问题

sections.title: 🧩 短语与搭配（8）
sections.body:
| 短语 | 意思 | 例句 |
|---|---|---|
| set off | 出发 | We **set off** before sunrise. |
| be engaged in | 从事；参与 | She **is engaged in** a conservation project. |
| do harm to | 对……有害 | Tourism can **do harm to** the environment. |
| in search of | 寻找 | They travelled **in search of** a quieter beach. |
| escape from | 从……逃离 | The deer **escaped from** the fire. |
| be specific about | 对……具体 | Be **specific about** what you want to see. |
| highlight the importance of | 强调……的重要性 | The guide **highlighted the importance of** conservation. |
| look back on | 回顾 | I often **look back on** that journey. |

sections.title: 📐 语法：-ed 形式作状语
sections.body:
| 类型 | 例句 | 相当于 |
|---|---|---|
| 原因 | **Tired**, he sat down. | Because he was tired |
| 条件 | **Given** more time, we would stay. | If we were given more time |
| 时间 | **Seen** from above, the lake is blue. | When it is seen from above |
| 伴随 | He walked away, **followed by his dog**. | and was followed by his dog |

**要点**
1. -ed 状语与主句主语构成被动关系
2. 可扩展为 "being + done"（正在被）或 "having been done"（已经被）
3. 否定式 not done / not having been done

**易错边界**
1. 逻辑主语不一致：**Seen** from the top, the valley looks like a map.（√，valley 是被看的）／**Seeing** from the top, the valley...（×）
2. 该用 -ing 却用 -ed：**Walking** in the forest, I saw a deer.（√，I 主动走）
3. 完成式遗漏：**Having finished** the track, we rested.（√）

**三个练习**
1. ________ (give) a map, we found the way easily. → **Given**
2. ________ (follow) by a guide, the tourists felt safe. → **Followed**
3. 改错：Seeing from the hill, the city is beautiful. → **Seen from the hill, the city is beautiful.**

sections.title: ✍️ 写作：旅行故事（travel tale）
sections.body:
**结构**：出发（时间地点）→ 途中（2–3 个事件，含一个转折）→ 感受与收获

**五个可套用句式**
1. **It was a trip I will never forget.** 这是一次我永远不会忘记的旅行。
2. **We set off at dawn, ...** 我们黎明出发，……
3. **Just as we..., something unexpected happened.** 就在我们……时，意外发生了。
4. **Tired but excited, we...** 疲惫但兴奋，我们……
5. **Looking back, I realize that...** 回头看，我意识到……

sections.title: 📖 阅读技能：梳理游记时间线
sections.body: 游记按时间推进：先找**时间标志词**（at dawn, later, by noon, finally），再找**地点变化**（moved on to, arrived at）。转折处（but, however, suddenly）往往是故事重点，也是考题常设处。

sections.title: 例题 1 · L1 词汇
sections.body:
用方框中的词填空：guideline / track / enthusiasm / conservation / escape

1. The hikers followed a narrow ______ up the mountain.
2. Wildlife ______ is important for the planet.
3. She talked about the trip with great ______.
4. The bird managed to ______ from the cage.
5. Please read the safety ______ before you start.

**解析**：1. track　2. conservation　3. enthusiasm　4. escape　5. guidelines

**💥 陷阱**：第 5 题 guideline 常用复数 guidelines。

**变式**：用 do harm to 造句，表达"乱扔垃圾会伤害野生动物"。→ Littering can do harm to wildlife.

sections.title: 例题 2 · L2 语法
sections.body:
用 -ed 形式改写：
1. Because he was tired, he stopped walking.
2. If we were given more time, we would explore the valley.
3. When it is seen from the top, the village looks tiny.

**解析**：
1. **Tired**, he stopped walking.
2. **Given** more time, we would explore the valley.
3. **Seen** from the top, the village looks tiny.

**💥 陷阱**：第 3 题用 Seeing（主动）导致逻辑主语错误。

**变式**：用 "followed by" 造句：The guide walked ahead, followed by six tourists.

sections.title: 例题 3 · L3 翻译
sections.body:
翻译下列句子：
1. 沿着山间小路走，我们看到了许多在城市里见不到的鸟。
2. 受到当地人的热情鼓舞，我们决定多留两天。
3. 回头看这次旅行，我意识到真正的收获不是照片，而是对自然的新认识。

**参考译文**：
1. **Walking** along the mountain **track**, we saw many birds that cannot be seen in the city.
2. **Encouraged by** the local people's **enthusiasm**, we decided to stay two more days.
3. **Looking back on** the trip, I realize the real **gain** was not photos but a new understanding of nature.

**采分点**：① -ing 作状语 + 定语从句；② -ed 作状语（Encouraged by）；③ look back on + not...but...

**💥 陷阱**：第 1 句用 Walked（被动）导致逻辑主语错误；第 2 句 encourage 后介词用成 with。

**变式**：把第 3 句改为强调句：It is not photos but a new understanding of nature that is the real gain.

sections.title: 🔑 核心词汇（10）
sections.body:
- **advertisement** n. 广告：put an **advertisement** 登广告；a misleading **advertisement** 误导性广告

- **genuine** adj. 真正的；真诚的：a **genuine** product 正品；**genuine** interest 真正的兴趣
- **contrary** adj./n. 相反的：**contrary** to 与……相反；on the **contrary** 恰恰相反
- **launch** v./n. 推出；发起：**launch** a product 推出产品；**launch** a campaign 发起活动

sections.title: 📐 语法：过去进行时与过去完成时的被动语态
sections.body:
| 时态 | 主动 | 被动 |
|---|---|---|
| 过去进行 | They **were repairing** the road. | The road **was being repaired**. |
| 过去完成 | They **had repaired** the road. | The road **had been repaired**. |

**用法**
1. 过去进行时被动：过去某时正在被……（was/were being done）
2. 过去完成时被动：到过去某时为止已经被……（had been done）
3. 常用于叙述中：When I arrived, the goods **were being loaded** and the bill **had been paid**.

**易错边界**
1. 漏 being：The road was repaired when I passed.（若强调"正在修"，应为 was being repaired）
2. had been 与 has been 混用：By last week, the order has been sent.（×）
3. 被动语态中的 by 短语滥用：The letter was written by him.（可，但不必每句都加）

3. 改错：The house was painted when we arrived. → **was being painted**（强调正在进行）

1. 非限制性定语从句可以用 that 引导吗？

### 🔑 核心词汇（10）

- **status** n. 状态；地位：social **status** 社会地位；update the **status** 更新状态
- **analyse** v. 分析：**analyse** data 分析数据；**analysis** n. 分析
- **compromise** n./v. 妥协：reach a **compromise** 达成妥协；**compromise** on 在……上妥协
- **profile** n. 个人资料：a social media **profile** 社交媒体主页；keep a low **profile** 保持低调
- **delete** v. 删除：**delete** a post 删除帖子；**delete** the file 删除文件
- **sympathetic** adj. 同情的：be **sympathetic** to 对……同情；**sympathy** n. 同情
- **potential** adj./n. 潜在的；潜力：**potential** risk 潜在风险；reach one's **potential** 发挥潜力
- **dare** v. 敢于：**dare** to do 敢于做；**dare** not do 不敢做
- **absorb** v. 吸收；使全神贯注：**absorb** information 吸收信息；be **absorbed** in 专注于
- **objective** adj./n. 客观的；目标：an **objective** view 客观看法；achieve an **objective** 实现目标

|---|---|---|

| be sympathetic to | 同情 | She **was sympathetic to** his situation. |
| be aware of | 意识到 | Users should **be aware of** the risks. |
| take control of | 控制 | **Take control of** your online time. |

|---|---|---|
